data.narrative:
Chai Discovery is a Series C biotech company founded by Joshua Meier (ex-Chief AI Officer at Absci, protein language modeling researcher at Meta/FAIR) and Jack Dent (ex-Stripe product/engineering lead). The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 3 public biotech equities (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers including Colossal Biosciences, New Limit, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Two triangulation methods apply. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C advancement to the $3.8B last post-money valuation, implying $6.5B. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (Colossal at $10.3B, New Limit at $3.1B, Eikon at $539M) yields a $3.1B median. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied absent disclosed revenue. These two methods produce a triangulated range of $2.6B (low) to $7.4B (high), with a median of $4.8B.

The current $3.8B valuation sits in the lower half of this range. Key uncertainties include the dispersion among peer valuations—the $539M-to-$10.3B spread reflects heterogeneity in stage, technology maturity, and capital efficiency within frontier biotech—and the absence of revenue data, limiting public-market calibration. Stage-progression and peer-median convergence suggests fair value likely spans $3.1B to $6.5B.
